title: San Francisco Travel Guide

hero.headline: San Francisco Travel Guide
hero.subheadline: Plan a high-value San Francisco itinerary with top neighborhoods, outdoor access, and proven tour ideas.

overview: San Francisco is a strong base for culture, food, and outdoor day plans. Build each day around one anchor area, then add nearby experiences to reduce transit time.
For first-time visitors, pair iconic landmarks with one local neighborhood each day. This gives you a more complete feel for San Francisco without over-scheduling.

highlights.title: Evening experiences
highlights.description: Reserve one night for live entertainment, dining, or waterfront walks.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Golden Gate Bridge
thingsToDo.description: Golden Gate Bridge is a bridge in San Francisco, California. It is part of the city's established network of cultural and public places. The setting includes identifiable physical features that make the site easy to distinguish. Its layout supports a mix of everyday activity and city-level events across the year. Historical records and civic references keep the site connected to the area's development story. Visitors usually experience a clear sense of place through the landmark's scale, access, and surrounding context.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Shoulder seasons are best for comfort and flexibility
bullets: Spring and fall typically offer the easiest weather for walking and tours.
Summer can be busy; reserve major attractions and timed entries early.
Winter trips can provide better rates and lighter midday crowds in many districts.

travelTips: Use early starts for major sights and popular viewpoints.
Pre-book top attractions and guided activities during peak months.
Keep one flexible block each day for weather or traffic changes.
Stay close to transit hubs if you want to minimize transfer time.

faq.q: How many days are ideal for San Francisco?
faq.a: Three to four days gives enough time for major attractions and one outdoor-focused day.

faq.q: Is San Francisco good for outdoor travelers?
faq.a: Yes. Most itineraries can combine city highlights with nearby hiking, water, or scenic touring options.

faq.q: Should I book tours in advance?
faq.a: For top-rated tours and peak travel weeks, advance booking is strongly recommended.
